meldstudio.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to Meld Studio.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to Meld Studio, for example when you close it.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.sceneChanged.description: Runs when Meld Studio switches to another scene on the live output.

fields.scene: Only react to these scenes, typed as Meld Studio shows them, like "Just Chatting". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any scene.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudio.oldSceneId: Meld's id for the old scene

meldstudio.recordingStarted.description: Runs when Meld Studio starts recording.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.recordingStopped.description: Runs when Meld Studio stops recording.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.streamingStarted.description: Runs when Meld Studio starts streaming. Good for a "going live" message.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.streamingStopped.description: Runs when Meld Studio stops streaming.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.event.description: Runs when anything in your Meld Studio session changes, like a layer, effect or audio track. For advanced users; the other Meld triggers are simpler.

fields.event: Which kind of change to react to. Pick Any to react to every change.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.event: The kind of change, like LayerVisibilityChanged
variables.meldStudioEvent._json: All details of the change as raw text
variables.meldStudioEvent.layerName: The layer that changed (for layer changes)
variables.meldStudioEvent.trackName: The audio track that changed (for track changes)
variables.meldStudioEvent.effectName: The effect that changed (for effect changes)

meldstudio.layerVisibilityChanged.description: Runs when a layer (like a camera or image) is shown or hidden in a Meld scene.

fields.layer: Only react to these layers (the things inside a scene, like a camera or image), typed as Meld shows them. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any layer.
fields.stateFilter: Pick Visible to react when a layer appears, Hidden when it disappears, or Any for both.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.visible: True when the layer is now shown
variables.meldStudioEvent.sceneName: The scene the layer is in

meldstudio.effectEnabledStateChanged.description: Runs when an effect on a layer is switched on or off in Meld.

fields.effect: Only react to these effects, typed as Meld shows them. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any effect.
fields.stateFilter: Pick Enabled to react when it turns on, Disabled when it turns off, or Any for both.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.enabled: True when the effect is now on
variables.meldStudioEvent.layerName: The layer the effect is on

meldstudio.trackMutedStateChanged.description: Runs when an audio track is muted or unmuted in Meld.

fields.track: Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track.
fields.stateFilter: Pick Muted to react when it is muted, Not muted when it is unmuted, or Any for both.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.trackName: The name of the audio track
variables.meldStudioEvent.muted: True when the track is now muted

meldstudio.trackMonitoringStateChanged.description: Runs when you start or stop listening to an audio track through your headphones (monitoring) in Meld.

fields.track: Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track.
fields.stateFilter: Pick Monitoring to react when listening starts, Not monitoring when it stops, or Any for both.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.trackName: The name of the audio track
variables.meldStudioEvent.monitoring: True when you are now listening to it

meldstudio.trackGainChanged.description: Runs when the volume of an audio track changes in Meld.

fields.track: Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on
variables.meldStudioEvent.trackName: The name of the audio track
variables.meldStudioEvent.muted: True if the track is muted

meldstudio.sceneStaged.description: Runs when you stage a scene in Meld (put it in the "up next" spot before showing it).

fields.scene: Only react to these scenes, typed as Meld Studio shows them, like "Just Chatting". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any scene.

variables.meldStudio.name: The name of the Meld Studio connection
variables.meldStudio.host: The computer Meld Studio runs on

meldstudio.showScene.description: Switches Meld Studio to another scene, live.

fields.scene: The scene name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Just Chatting". Its id also works.

meldstudio.getCurrentScene.description: Finds out which scene Meld Studio is showing and keeps it for later steps.

variables.currentScene: The name of the live scene
variables.currentSceneId: Meld's id for the live scene

meldstudio.getStatus.description: Checks whether Meld Studio is connected, recording or streaming and keeps the answers for later steps.

variables.meldStudio.isConnected: True if Cuebot is connected to Meld

meldstudio.recording.description: Starts or stops recording in Meld Studio.

fields.state: Start begins recording, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now.

variables.meldStudio.isRecording: True if Meld is recording afterwards

meldstudio.streaming.description: Starts or stops your stream in Meld Studio.

fields.state: Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now.

variables.meldStudio.isStreaming: True if Meld is streaming afterwards

meldstudio.takeScreenshot.description: Takes a screenshot in Meld Studio. Meld saves the picture itself.

fields.orientation: Horizontal is the normal wide picture, Vertical is the tall (phone) one.

variables.screenshotSuccess: True if Meld took the screenshot

meldstudio.takeVerticalScreenshot.description: Takes a tall (phone-shaped) screenshot in Meld Studio.

variables.screenshotSuccess: True if Meld took the screenshot

meldstudio.setLayerVisibility.description: Shows or hides a layer (like a camera or image) in a Meld scene.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works.
fields.state: Visible shows it, Hidden hides it, Toggle flips it.

variables.meldStudio.layerVisible: True if the layer is shown afterwards

meldstudio.setEffectState.description: Turns an effect on a Meld layer on or off.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works.
fields.effect: The effect name as Meld shows it. Its id also works.
fields.state: Enabled turns it on, Disabled turns it off, Toggle flips it.

variables.meldStudio.effectEnabled: True if the effect is on afterwards

meldstudio.setLayerTrackMuted.description: Mutes or unmutes the sound of one layer, like a game capture.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The layer name as Meld shows it, like "Webcam" (a layer is one item inside a scene). Its id also works.
fields.state: Muted silences it, Not Muted turns it back on, Toggle flips it.

variables.meldStudio.trackMuted: True if the sound is muted afterwards

meldstudio.setTrackMuted.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio track, like your microphone.

fields.track: The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works.
fields.state: Muted silences it, Not Muted turns it back on, Toggle flips it.

variables.meldStudio.trackMuted: True if the track is muted afterwards

meldstudio.setBrowserLayerUrl.description: Makes a browser layer in Meld open a different web page.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The browser layer name as Meld shows it. Its id also works.
fields.url: The web address to open, like "https://example.com/alert".

meldstudio.setLayerSource.description: Swaps the picture or video shown by an image or media layer.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The image or media layer name as Meld shows it.
fields.source: The file on your computer, like "C:\Pictures\happy.png", or a web link starting with file://.

meldstudio.setTrackMonitoring.description: Turns on or off listening to an audio track through your headphones (monitoring).

fields.track: The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works.
fields.state: Monitoring starts listening, Not Monitoring stops, Toggle flips it.

variables.meldStudio.trackMonitoring: True if monitoring is on afterwards

meldstudio.setTrackGain.description: Sets the volume of an audio track.

fields.track: The audio track: a global track name like "Microphone", or a layer name for that layer's sound. Its id also works.
fields.gain: The volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full), like 0.5 for half.

meldstudio.stageScene.description: Puts a scene in the "up next" spot in Meld, so you can show it later with "Show staged scene". Vertical scenes cannot be staged.

fields.scene: The scene name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Just Chatting". Its id also works.

meldstudio.showStagedScene.description: Shows the scene you staged earlier in Meld Studio.

meldstudio.recordClip.description: Saves a short clip of the last moments in Meld Studio.

fields.seconds: How many seconds to save, 1 to 90. Leave empty or 0 for the longest Meld can do.

meldstudio.replay.description: Shows or hides the instant replay in Meld Studio.

fields.mode: Show plays the replay, Dismiss closes it.

meldstudio.toggleVirtualCamera.description: Turns the Meld Studio virtual camera on if it is off, and off if it is on.

meldstudio.mediaControl.description: Plays, pauses or jumps within a video or sound layer in Meld Studio.

fields.scene: The scene the layer is in, as Meld shows it. Leave empty to look in the live scene first, then in all scenes.
fields.layer: The media layer name as Meld shows it.
fields.mediaAction: Play, Pause, or Seek to jump to a time.
fields.seconds: Only for Seek: the time to jump to, in seconds from the start.

meldstudio.widgetEvent.description: Presses a button on a Meld widget, like firing confetti, resetting a countdown or adding time to a subathon timer.

fields.eventType: The widget event name, like "CONFETTIPOP_TRIGGER" or "COUNTDOWN_RESET". Pick one from the suggestions.
fields.amount: Only for SUBATHONTIMER_ADDTIME: how many seconds to add.

meldstudio.setProperty.description: Changes one setting of a Meld scene, layer, effect or track. For advanced users who know the setting names.

fields.item: The scene, layer, effect or track name as Meld shows it. Its id also works.
fields.property: Which setting to change, like visible, x, y, width, height, url or name.
fields.value: The new value, like true, 10 or some text.

meldstudio.sendCommand.description: Sends Meld Studio one of its own commands by name. For advanced users.

fields.command: The command name, like "meld.screenshot" or "meld.recordClip". Pick one from the suggestions.

meldstudio.getScenes.description: Reads the names of all your Meld scenes and keeps them for later steps.

variables.meldStudio.scenes: The list of scene names, as text
